Container.Name: MuseForge
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted AI media studio: video, images, audio, long-form text and complete audiobooks, all generated locally on your own GPU. Nothing is sent to a cloud service.
Besides direct generation it includes a Director mode that plans a whole music video or short film from one sentence, a Storywriter for novel-length prose with translation and a continuity audit, and an audiobook producer that turns a document into spoken chapters with a voice per character.
Everything the web interface can do is also a REST API, and a built-in MCP endpoint lets AI agents drive it directly.
REQUIREMENTS - please read before installing: * An NVIDIA GPU with at least 6 GB VRAM. There is no AMD or CPU-only mode. * The Unraid "Nvidia-Driver" plugin, installed and working. * Roughly 150 GB of free space for model weights. Point the appdata paths below at a fast pool, not at spinning disks.
Model weights are NOT contained in the image. The first time you use a given model its files download once - often tens of gigabytes for a video model - before anything appears. Later runs on that model start immediately.
Container.Description: Self-hosted AI studio for video, images, audio, long-form text and audiobooks. Runs entirely on your own NVIDIA GPU. Requires the Nvidia-Driver plugin and about 150 GB for model weights.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web interface and REST API. 7861 avoids clashing with a Maestro instance on the same machine.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use. 'all', or paste a specific GPU UUID from Tools -> System Devices.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver capabilities exposed to the container. 'all' is required - compute alone is not enough for the video pipeline.

Config.Name: HF_HOME
Config.Description: Where the Hugging Face download cache lives inside the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: MuseForge API token
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the MCP endpoint requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Set this before reaching MuseForge from outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Hugging Face token
Config.Description: Optional. Not needed for the default models, but lifts anonymous rate limits and unlocks gated repositories.

Config.Name: Model weights (large!)
Config.Description: Downloaded model weights. This is the big one - plan for 150 GB or more, and put it on a fast pool.

Config.Name: Outputs
Config.Description: Generated video, images, audio, stories and audiobook projects. Point this at a share if you want the results on the array.

Config.Name: Hugging Face cache
Config.Description: Download cache. Keeping it means a reinstall does not re-download everything.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Application configuration and the saved queue.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Reference images, videos and audio you upload as inputs.
